title: Business Central 2025 wave 2 (BC27): Editable fields in page customizations
summary: In BC27, page fields defined in page customizations can be made editable; before this they were always read-only. This needs runtime 16.0 or later, and the source table field must have AllowInCustomizations set to AsReadWrite. Standard fields default to ToBeClassified, so they cannot be made editable, and page extensions are not affected by this property.
key_points: Page customization fields can now be marked editable, where before they were always read-only
Runtime 16.0 or later is required, and older runtimes give error AL0666
The source field needs AllowInCustomizations set to AsReadWrite; ToBeClassified and Always behave like AsReadOnly and give error AL0808
On table extensions the property applies only to fields declared in the extension, not to base table fields
Page extensions are not controlled by this property

quotes.text: You can now make page fields defined in page customizations editable. Previously, such fields were always read-only.
quotes.why_it_matters: This addresses a key limitation in page customizations that previously restricted all customization fields to read-only status.
